"''So good to see you.|Mon Mothma greeting Beeva and his wife at her estate|audio=SenatorBeeva-OneYearLater.flac|}} '''Beeva''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], he and his [[Beeva's wife|wife]] attended the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of the [[Chandrilan]]s [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Chandrila]]. On the first [[Local day|day]] of the three-[[Standard day|day]] event, Leida's [[Parent|mother]], Senator [[Mon Mothma]], greeted Beeva and his wife while passing the couple on one of the estate's exterior stairways. Beeva greeted her back with a nod. He had dark skin and [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s. While at the [[Marriage|wedding]], Beeva wore a tan [[clothing|outfit]] with a matching [[hat]] and [[cloak]] fastened by a gold-colored loop. His [[belt]] and the loop on his hat were also golden. ==Behind the scenes== Beeva appeared in "[[One Year Later]]," the first episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The scene in which Beeva is introduced was filmed as a "[[Wikipedia:Long take|oner]]" and was the final visual effects shot filmed for the season, completed in collaboration between [[Industrial Light & Magic]] and [[Scanline VFX]] on [[August 5]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/andor-trivia-guide-week-4|text=Secrets from the Set of ''Andor'' Season 2: Week 4 Trivia}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Beeva}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ビーヴァ |ka=ბივა }} [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
